contracts: v2 management uses borrowed live I/O and production finish_framed_management after a fully parsed or flushed short reply.
Only pure FIN/EOF stage selects interruption; once join begins, the exact LinkOwner is retained and unconditionally awaited.
Confirmed FIN/EOF uses natural join and requires PeerEof; failure/timeout/caller stop requests stop and joins.
Discovery includes short close in its original caller deadline, preserves Ok(None) cooperative stop, and retains outer owner if parsing fails.
Client IMPORT retains I/O on errors, performs bounded v2 short close, preserves the original business error; successful IMPORT proceeds on the same stream without FIN.

Native Catalog and fully flushed status2/status4 short refusal share this completion; foreground helper-prepare refusal adds completion only after actual helper result. Managed helper-error EOF behavior is unchanged.
Raw-v1 skips framing completion and preserves its original ownership path.
Actual USB helper ownership/cleanup and durable recording remain separate; no accepted helper operation is newly canceled.

new_test_sources.name: actual_native_catalog_and_short_refusal_finish_on_the_same_tls_owner
new_test_sources.scope: Actual Native service connection handler with no exports, real TCP/mTLS v1 and v2, two public service discoveries and one fixed IMPORT refusal; no helper/device operation.

new_test_sources.name: actual_client_refusal_keeps_original_failure_without_helper_attempt
new_test_sources.scope: Actual service client owner; real TCP/mTLS catalog then status2/status4 refusal in both v1/v2. A nonexistent helper endpoint must remain unused; business Protocol failure, cleanup and recording results separate.

new_test_sources.name: discovery_stop_during_peer_fin_wait_retains_and_joins_the_driver
new_test_sources.scope: Real TCP/mTLS v2; peer observes client FIN but deliberately withholds its FIN. Cooperative stop must return after actual owned driver join; peer subsequently joins its real interrupted driver. No sleep/retry.
